rows.note: Use this for food or drink described as high in calories rather than merely related to calories.

example.english: This cheesecake is calorific, so one slice is enough.
example.traditional: 呢款芝士蛋糕高熱量，食一件就夠喇。

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something is related to calories.

example.english: This label has calorific information, so read it carefully before eating.
example.traditional: 呢張標籤有同卡路里有關嘅資料，食之前睇清楚啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 biu1 cim1 jau5 tung4 kaa1 lou6 lei5 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 zi1 liu2 sik6 zi1 cin4 tai2 cing1 co2 di1

rows.note: Use this for something that produces heat or energy, not simply something measured in calories.

example.english: This fuel is calorific, so the water boils quickly.
example.traditional: 呢種燃料好產熱嘅，煲水好快滾。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 jin4 liu2 hou2 caan2 jit6 ge3 bou1 seoi2 hou2 faai3 gwan2
